notes: Statement change, equivalent: in `norm_eval_le_sum_norm_coeff`, `MvPolynomial.coeff d P` becomes `P.coeff d`. `MvPolynomial.coeff` no longer exists. At the pin it was defined as `⇑(AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff p) m`, which is exactly what `P.coeff d` (`AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff`) means on the target, and `MvPolynomial.support` is `p.coeff.support` in both versions. Also `Finset.prod_le_one` no longer takes the nonnegativity hypothesis; use `Finset.prod_le_one₀`, which has the original arguments.
